title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_smoothie_bowls_by_rose_marie_donhauser_1if7r (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_smoothie_bowls_by_rose_marie_donhauser_1if7r' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run.
